justification: GATE-1 (part 1): the engine computed realistic_dwellings as envelope_gfa/65 regardless of the permitted built FORM, so a dwelling_house on R2 reported 6 dwellings (the visible Haberfield wrongness). By the Standard Instrument a dwelling house is ONE dwelling; only multi-unit forms scale with GFA. Route both the headline yield and the parking dwelling-estimate through a form-aware helper so the engine never over-reports an impermissible yield.

pre_impl.existing_data: compute_constraint_arithmetic already receives a dev_type and has _is_apartment_type; realistic_dwellings (and the parking est_dwellings) divided the GFA envelope by MIN_DWELLING_GFA_M2 (65) for every form, ignoring whether the form is a single dwelling, dual occupancy or a multi-unit building.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Three existing tests asserted dwelling_house -> 6/6/4 dwellings (the GFA/65 model) and passed for a year — they encoded the bug as correct. They have been corrected to the Standard Instrument meaning (a dwelling house is one dwelling); the GFA-division path is now covered for multi-unit forms in test_dwelling_form.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data source: a pure helper _dwellings_for_form(dev_type, gfa_based) gates the existing GFA-based count by built form. dev_type is still passed in (currently hardcoded 'dwelling_house' upstream); deriving it from the live zone is GATE-1 part 2.
pre_impl.external_source_error: N/A for this change - the helper is pure and consumes no external source; it only re-maps an already-computed integer. Upstream Portal/DB failures are unchanged.
pre_impl.frontend_type: N/A - backend yield computation only; the ConstraintArithmeticResult.realistic_dwellings type (int) is unchanged, so no frontend boundary shifts. The capacity card stays unexposed.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If a permitted denser form is mislabelled as dwelling_house upstream, the yield UNDER-reports (1 instead of the permitted count) — conservative and visible, never an over-report of an impermissible yield. Lifting that under-report is GATE-1 part 2 (zone-derived dev_type).

functions.name: _dwellings_for_form
functions.input: the development type string and the raw GFA-based dwelling count integer
functions.output: the dwelling count appropriate to the built form: 1 for a dwelling house, 2 for dual occupancy, GFA-based for multi-unit forms
functions.if_none: an empty or unrecognised dev_type returns 1 (conservative single-dwelling default, never over-reporting)

values: N/A - no regulatory values hardcoded; MIN_DWELLING_GFA_M2 (65) is an existing yield constant unchanged here. Form classification reuses the existing _is_apartment_type keyword set plus terrace/townhouse/manor/medium-density.
queries: N/A - no database queries; the helper is a pure function of dev_type and an integer.

break_it.scenario: Dwelling house on a generous envelope (R2, FSR 0.5, 793 m2 -> ~397 m2)
break_it.what_happens: Pre-GATE-1 the engine reported 6 dwellings (397/65) for a single-dwelling form — an impermissible yield

break_it.scenario: Dual occupancy form on a large lot with a generous GFA envelope
break_it.what_happens: GFA/65 could report 5-6 units for a form limited to two dwellings
break_it.how: _dwellings_for_form returns 2 for any 'dual' form; test_dual_occupancy_yields_two asserts == 2

break_it.scenario: A genuine multi-unit form must still scale with GFA
break_it.what_happens: Over-correcting to 1 would under-report a residential flat building / apartment
break_it.how: _is_apartment_type forms return the GFA-based count; test_residential_flat_building_scales_with_gfa asserts > 1 and parametric cases lock each form

break_it.scenario: Unknown or empty dev_type string that maps to no known built form
break_it.what_happens: An unmapped form could fall through to the GFA/65 over-report
break_it.how: the default branch returns 1 (conservative); parametric tests cover '' and an unknown use

break_it.scenario: Parking estimate inflated by the old per-dwelling count
break_it.what_happens: est_dwellings (GFA/65) multiplied the parking rate, over-stating parking for a single dwelling
break_it.repro: dwelling_house brief with a DCP car_parking rate
break_it.how: the parking est_dwellings now also routes through _dwellings_for_form (line ~570), so parking scales with the real form count

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-run the Haberfield brief and confirm Development Capacity shows 1 dwelling (not 6) for the dwelling_house form. GATE-1 part 2 (derive dev_type from the live zone's permitted uses via DevelopmentPermissionsDB, fail-safe to conservative) is the next step and lifts the R3/R4 under-report. Engine stays unexposed (#513 unmerged) until the legality gates complete.
